VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JULY 15, 2026
  3820 CHERRY AVENUE, LONG BEACH, 90807
  EAST ROOM, 5:00 PM

Kenneth Osborn, Chair  James Goodin, Commissioner
Antawnette Atkins Blade, Vice Chair  Hershell Hardimon, Commissioner
Jerry Earl, Commissioner  Nicholas Sramek, Commissioner

 Members of the public have the option to email public comments to Veterans@longbeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55479  Recommendation to receive and file opening remarks from the Chair.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55480  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Veterans Affairs Commission
  meeting of Wednesday, May 20, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55481  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-55494  Recommendation to receive and file a report on the activities of the Office of
  Veterans Support.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Veterans Affairs Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT
